SELECT DISTINCT A.BUSS_NO id,A.BUSS_NO text from ASSET_LOSS_RESULT A WHERE 1=1
and A.BUSS_NO like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%')

SELECT A.SEQNO seqNo, A.PROD_ID prodId, A.PROD_NAME prodName, A.ASSET_ID assetId, A.ASSET_NAME assetName, A.ASSET_TYPE assetType, A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, A.BUSS_NO bussNo, 'T01' ps, A.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, A.DEC_DATE decDate, A.PRIN_OVERDUE_DAY prinOverdueDay, A.INT_OVERDUE_DAY intOverdueDay, A.PURCHASE_TIME_GRADE purchaseTimeGrade, A.CURRENT_TIME_GRADE currentTimeGrade, A.PRE_PROSPECTIVE_PD preProspectivePd, A.PROSPECTIVE_PD prospectivePd, A.STAGE stage, A.LGD lgd, A.EAD ead, A.PRE_PROSPECTIVE_ECL preProspectiveEcl, A.PROSPECTIVE_ECL prospectiveEcl, A.ALLOW_MODEL_COVER allowModelCover, A.DATA_SOURCE dataSource FROM ASSET_LOSS_RESULT A WHERE A.SEQNO = #{seqNo}

SELECT fp.FINPROD_ID id, FINPROD_ABBR text, fpt.TYPE_8 || '/' || fpt.TYPE_9 || '/' || fpt.TYPE_10 || '/' || fpt.TYPE_11 || '/' || fpt.TYPE_12 as object FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp left join fin_product_type fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=fpt.FINPROD_ID inner join PTL_SEC_POSITION psp on fp.FINPROD_ID=psp.FINPROD_ID WHERE P_FINPROD_ID is null and psp.AMOUNT != 0 and (FINPROD_TYPE2 ='F01' or (FINPROD_TYPE2='F18' and fpt.type_9 IN('08','09')) or FINPROD_TYPE2='F07' )
and (fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or fp.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
and (fp.FINPROD_ABBR=#{initValue} or fp.FINPROD_ID =#{initValue})

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID id,A.FINPROD_ABBR text FROM FIN_PRODUCT A WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND A.PROFIT_TYPE != '03'
and (A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or A.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID as id, NVL(NVL(B.FINPROD_ABBR,B.Finprod_Name),A.FINPROD_ID) AS text, A.TYPE_18 AS object FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.Type_18 IN ('01','13')
AND (A.FINPROD_ID LIKE concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') OR (B.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') OR B.Finprod_Name LIKE concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%')))
SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS id, nvl(A.BOOKSET_NAME, A.BOOKSET_FULLNAME) AS text FROM BOK_BOOKSET A WHERE A.BOOKSET_TYPE = '02' and A.ACCT_MODE = '03'
